purpose.zh: 单腿站着练胯转开转回，胯更灵活有劲
purpose.en: Standing on one leg, turns your hips open and back to make them more mobile and strong.

text.zh: 胯和上身一起，慢慢转开
text.en: Turn your hips and chest together, slowly opening up

text.zh: 单腿站稳，膝盖微弯，一只手轻扶椅子。
text.en: Stand on one leg, knee soft, one hand resting on the chair.

text.zh: 转开一点再转回来，腰别自己扭。
text.en: Open a little, then turn back. Don't twist at the waist.

commonErrors.en: Twisting your waist instead of turning at the hip.

commonErrors.zh: 转开时站着那条腿的膝盖往里扣
commonErrors.en: Standing knee caving in as you turn open.

cautions.zh: 两手扶住椅背，站不稳就转小点
cautions.en: Both hands on the chair. If you're wobbly, turn less.

changes: 节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：转 1.5/停 1.5/回 2.5/歇 2.5 s（派生 0.9/2.3/1.5/3.4）
主口令去「绕支撑髋」；口令「回正」→「慢慢转回」
节奏按真实带练：一下 8.0 s → 5.0 s（转开 2.0 / 停 1.0 / 转回 2.0），单腿大范围慢做
站着原地换边，不加换边准备
purpose「练单腿站时髋部的转动控制」→「练胯转开转回」；「骨盆」→「胯」
